name: Bari
notes: Bari: Agenzia delle Entrate OMI average residential quotation per OMI zone, EUR/m2 (27 zones with at least two points, 2019-2025). Quotations are the OMI's valuation ranges (min/max) built from deeds, offers and surveys: a mid-point, not a transaction price and not quality-adjusted. Annual figures (xlsx 'Grandi citta - Dati per zona OMI'), stamped 1 July; the build interpolates the quarters between years. The city line is a chain-linked composite of the zones, weighted by transactions (NTN). A zone level is dropped when the next year's published change disagrees with the ratio of the levels by more than 3 points. Zones were redrawn in the 2024 revision.
